overview: Targeted LNP and RNA-delivery expertise, with pharmaceutical experience in ophthalmic new-modality development, excipient evaluation and external technology due diligence.

strengths.title: Specialize in targeted LNPs
strengths.text: Develop cell-specific LNPs by connecting ligand modification, lipid composition and administration route with the biology that controls delivery.

strengths.title: Discover and validate unexpected delivery routes
strengths.text: I connect ideas across disciplines to uncover how LNPs can enter specific cells, then test those ideas experimentally. This approach has led to ApoE-mediated lymphatic delivery and cell-specific LNP inventions.

strengths.title: Code to understand complex biology
strengths.text: I write code for proteomics and RNA-seq analyses. This gives me practical experience interpreting large biological datasets alongside formulation and functional readouts.

strengths.title: Build methods and develop people
strengths.text: Academic experience establishing LNP manufacturing and evaluation methods, applying DoE, and supervising graduate and international students. Pharmaceutical experience includes multidisciplinary teams and external partnerships.

workingApproach: Three academic studies connect a delivery problem, a different hypothesis and experimental evidence. My role is stated alongside each result.

researchRecord.title: Funded research on antibody-targeted LNPs
researchRecord.text: Led a JSPS KAKENHI project on ligand modification through click chemistry and systematic evaluation. The completed project reported antibody-directed siRNA delivery to lymphatic endothelial cells.

methodExamples.label: PUBLISHED DoE EXAMPLE
methodExamples.title:
Five factors.
Sixteen experimental conditions.
methodExamples.text: A two-level design varied five formulation and administration factors. The objective was sentinel-node selectivity, connecting formulation choices to a defined biological outcome.
methodExamples.contribution: Co-first and co-corresponding author; credited for conceptualization, experiments, data curation, visualization and writing.

methodExamples.label: PUBLISHED PROTEOMICS EXAMPLE
methodExamples.title: Read the biological response.
methodExamples.text: SWATH-MS quantified 1,899 proteins to compare mRNA-LNPs with a commercial transfection reagent in cultured human brain endothelial cells. The LNP formulation caused fewer protein-expression changes under the study conditions.
methodExamples.contribution: Co-first and co-corresponding author; credited for software, methodology, visualization, supervision and project administration.
